_comment: How bad a dig gets. base/per_depth are the assault curves; surge is the surfacing burst. WHO comes out is not decided here: each hole's own file declares its fauna (config/holes/). holes.reach is how close he must stand to a passage to be offered the way through. formulas table is the derivation table for every species -- hp/contact/speed/xp derive from a pest's sheet (resistance/defensiveness/dispersal) the way the player's numbers derive from his (config/stats.json), and smell is the per-individual roll, hotter with depth, that multiplies all of it.
